apt_get_download_only.description: Value for APT::Get::Download-Only. Controls whether apt-get downloads packages without installing them.

acquire_retries.description: Number of retries for Acquire operations.

dselect_clean.description: Value for DSelect::Clean. Controls cleanup behavior for dselect method. Values: always, auto, prompt, never.

dpkg_options.description: Default options passed to dpkg. Enclosed in quotes in the config.
